question.text: What will Grand Theft Auto VI's PS5 Metascore be on December 20, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the Metascore (critic score) displayed on [Metacritic](https://www.metacritic.com/)'s page for Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5, as checked on December 20, 2026.
question.fine_print:
* If the PS5 page shows no Metascore, the Xbox Series X Metascore may be used instead.
* If neither platform shows a Metascore, or the game has not been released before December 20, 2026, the question is **annulled**.
* The closest Internet Archive snapshot may be used if the resolution time has been missed.

***
This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46100) which opened on 2026-10-26 17:00:00. This question will resolve based on the resolution criteria and fine print of the linked original question. However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. Additionally, if the original question's resolution could have been known before this question opened, then this question will be annulled.

research:
## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-04: Metacritic's Grand Theft Auto VI page (PS5 and Xbox Series X) shows the Metascore as "tbd" with 0 critic reviews. It says "Critic reviews are not available for this game yet" and lists the release date as November 19, 2026. [Metacritic](https://www.metacritic.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. No reviews are out and no score is shown.
- 2026-11-04: The release is still on track. Rockstar has confirmed November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloads start November 10 and the PS5 version needs about 212 GB. [ifun.de](https://www.ifun.de/gta-vi-preload-ab-10-november-und-ssd-rabatt-fuer-die-ps5-294175/), [Vice](https://www.vice.com/en/article/gta-6-midnight-release-times-file-size-preload/)
- If the game ships on time, the question is very unlikely to be annulled. Kalshi puts on-time release at 96%.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-03/04: Rockstar and PlayStation confirmed release logistics: midnight local-time launch, preload moved earlier from November 12 to November 10, 212 GB on PS5, and physical copies that are a download code rather than a game disc. [netzwelt](https://www.netzwelt.de/news/260286-gta-6-preload-startet-frueher-rockstar-noch-2-geschenke-fans.html), [tomshw](https://www.tomshw.it/videogioco/gta-6-su-ps5-confermati-212-gb-di-spazio-richiesto-mappa-fisica-assente-dalle-copie-in-scatola)
- 2026-10-26: Insider NateTheHate reported that review codes are going out to media and that the review embargo lifts November 18. Insider Gaming says it verified this independently. Rockstar and Take-Two have not confirmed it, and the time of day is unknown (one unconfirmed report says about 6-7am EST). [NateTheHate on X](https://x.com/NateTheHate2/status/2114749073953873963), [tbreak](https://tbreak.com/gta-6-review-codes-embargo-november-18/), [Beebom](https://beebom.com/gta-6-review-embargo-date-revealed/)
- 2026-10: Leaker BlackBate claimed some outlets may not be allowed to publish until launch day. This is a weaker source. [EGamers](https://egamers.io/gta-6-review-embargo-reportedly-lifts-november-18th-but-some-outlets-may-wait-until-launch/)
- 2026-08 (late): The first previews were hands-off only, with no one playing the game. Impressions were broadly very positive, with some describing it as "GOTY material" and noting a slower, more life-sim-leaning design. There were minor fan complaints about the UI and weapon wheel. [Pure Xbox](https://purexbox.com/news/2026/08/roundup-the-first-hands-off-previews-are-starting-to-roll-in-for-gta-6), [The Nerd Stash](https://thenerdstash.com/as-expected-the-gta-6-previews-confirmed-that-it-is-indeed-everything-we-were-hoping-for-and-more/), [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/GTA-6-preview-had-one-major-let-down-and-fans-hate-it.1381986.0.html)

## 4. Base rates
These Metascores are from memory and I did not re-check them this session.
- **Rockstar flagship games:** GTA III 97, Vice City 95, San Andreas 95, GTA IV 98 (PS3/X360), GTA V 97 (PS3/X360), Red Dead Redemption 95, RDR2 97 (PS4/Xbox One).
- **Other Rockstar titles:** Max Payne 3 about 87, L.A. Noire about 89.
- **Recent top-tier releases, for comparison:** Elden Ring 96, Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom 96, Baldur's Gate 3 96.
- **How much the score moves after the embargo:** For blockbusters, the Metascore usually shifts by about 0-2 points (often downward) as more reviews come in after the first wave. By about a month after release it is usually stable within ±1. December 20 is about 4.5 weeks after the reported embargo.
- **Platform differences:** PS5 and Xbox Series X scores on Metacritic often differ by 1-2 points, and the PS5 page usually has more reviews.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-11-04, Kalshi "GTA VI Metacritic score" (I have not checked which platform it resolves on). Implied probability of "Above X":
  - Above 80: 0.95
  - Above 85: 0.96
  - Above 90: 0.94
  - Above 95: 0.80

  - Above 97: 0.33
  - Above 98: 0.14
  - Above 99: 0.06
  - Read as a distribution: about 22% on 96, 25% on 97, 19% on 98, and a median around 96-97.
- 2026-11-04, Manifold "What score will GTA VI get on Metacritic?" (PS5 Metascore, checked at least two weeks after release): at least 90: 92%; at least 95: 77%; at least 97: 60%; at least 98: 50%. This market looks more bullish than Kalshi and has internal inconsistencies, such as "at least 70" priced below "at least 75". [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Tripping/what-score-will-grand-theft-auto-vi)
- A second Manifold market, [gallerdude](https://manifold.markets/gallerdude/what-will-the-metacritic-score-of-g), shows a headline number of 92%. I did not verify what that number means.
- I found no expert forecasts beyond these markets.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-10: Preloads begin. This is a possible window for leaks or early reviews from people who get copies early.
- 2026-11-18 (reported, not confirmed): Review embargo lifts. The first Metascore will probably appear that day. It is the key signal.
- 2026-11-19: Launch. Any outlets held back by a split embargo, and late reviewers, would add reviews after this.
- Late November to mid-December: The score could drift as more reviews arrive. Possible causes include launch bugs, performance problems, or day-one patch issues, which some outlets factor into their scores.
- 2026-12-20: Resolution check on Metacritic's PS5 page. The Xbox score is used only if the PS5 page has no Metascore.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) Time left: about 46 days until the December 20, 2026 check. The first real signal is the reported November 18 review embargo, two weeks from now.

(b) Latest known value: on 2026-11-04 Metacritic shows "tbd" with 0 critic reviews on the PS5 and Xbox Series X pages.

(c) If nothing changed: there would be no score, and the question would be annulled. That is unlikely, since markets put on-time release at about 96%.

(d) If the current trend continued: the only signals are previews, which are glowing but hands-off, and Rockstar's flagship history. GTA IV scored 98, GTA V and RDR2 scored 97, and the weaker flagships scored 95. Together these point to a launch score of about 96-97.

(e) Historical variation: for blockbusters, the Metascore usually drifts 0-2 points, mostly downward, between the embargo and one month later. By about 4.5 weeks after launch it is usually stable within ±1.

(f) Markets:
- Kalshi gives P(>95) = 0.80, P(>96) = 0.58, P(>97) = 0.33, P(>98) = 0.14 and P(>99) = 0.06. That puts the median around 97, with the mass concentrated on 96-98.
- Manifold is more bullish but internally inconsistent.
- I shade the upper tail a little lower than Kalshi, because a 99-100 score is extremely rare and late reviews tend to pull the score down.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- Low outcome: severe launch performance problems or bugs, plus critics souring on the slower, life-sim pacing or the online and monetization focus. Divisive reviews could then drag the score to about 85-90, similar to how other big franchises have dipped.
- High outcome: near-universal 100s and 10/10s like GTA IV, which held 98-99 through the first month.
